content.what_it_is: Commented tutorial variant of plot_wave.m for the FUNWAVE-TVD inlet_shoal case with a marked User Input section (L4-L23). fdir is assigned twice: '../bathy/' (L9) immediately overridden by a hard-coded Windows path 'C:\\Users\\Michael Lam\\Desktop\\simple_cases_input\\inlet_shoal\\' (L10). Snapshot list nfile=[5 20] (L13) with time labels times={'150' '600'} (L16) and a plot_color_bars=true toggle (L19). Loads dep.out (L26), builds grid dx=dy=2.0 (L30-L33), sponge outline x 0-180 (L36-L37), wavemaker outline x 240-260 (L40-L41), 8x5 inch figure (L46-L48). Loop over snapshots (L52-L102): zero-padded filename via sprintf('%.5d',...) (L56, explained L54-L55), loads eta_ and mask_ (L59-L60), masks dry cells eta(mask==0)=NaN (L64), subplot 1xN (L67), pcolor shading flat (L70), caxis([-0.5 2]) (L72), title with time label (L73), sponge and wavemaker overlays with rotated white text (L78-L84) between hold on/off (L77, L85), ylabel only for leftmost subplot (L89-L91), xlabel (L93), and conditional colorbar labeled '\\eta (m)' when plot_color_bars is true (L96-L99). Final print to jpeg is commented out (L103).
entities: fdir directory string L9 and L10 (second overrides first)
times cell array of time labels L16
unresolved: the L9 fdir='../bathy/' is dead code overridden at L10 by a personal Windows path; the intended shipped default is ambiguous
snapshot/time pairing differs from sibling plot_wave.m (nfile=[5 7], '200'/'300' there vs [5 20], '150'/'600' here); which pairing matches the case output interval is not determinable from this file
L10 path says simple_cases_input yet eta_/mask_ are model output files; directory naming inconsistency
